jobs.occupation: Barkhausen Institut gGmbH: Senior Engineer “Digital Hardware-Design” (m/w/d) (Embedded-Systems-Entwickler/in)
jobs.description: The Barkhausen Institut performs research on the latest hardware, software and communication technologies and demonstrates their application in tomorrow’s society. Our goal is to build a flexible and trustworthy IoT platform based on reliable electronics and secure communication methods.The group Scalable Computing Hardware is developing a secure and dependable multiprocessor system-on-chip (MPSoC) to establish a hardware platform for applications in the area of connected electronic systems.At the earliest possible date we are looking for aSenior Engineer “Digital Hardware Design” (m/w/d)The position will initially be filled for a period of 2 years and will be remunerated in line with TV-L E-13.Your responsibilities will include- Designing, developing and integrating digital hardware architectures for ASIC and FPGA designs- Independently defining, planning, and leading hardware architecture concepts- Implementing, simulating, and verifying digital hardware on RTL level using EDA software tools- Supporting FPGA prototyping and ASIC front-end design through to tape-out- Collaborating with backend teams to analyze and optimize RTL designs- Creating design and verification documentation- Setting up and managing Git flows and CI/CD pipelinesWe expect the following- Above-average M.Sc./Diploma degree in the field of electrical engineering/computer science or a comparable qualification- An integrative and cooperative personality with excellent communication and social skills- Very strong programming skills in Verilog/VHDL and Python- At least 5 years of professional experience in ASIC design, including working with modern EDA software tools (Cadence, Synopsys, open-source)- Very good communication and writing skills in English and German- Basic technical knowledge in the areas of processor systems and hardware securityYou are interested, but you don’t think you meet all the requirements of the job posting? Then you should know: We don’t hire resumes, we hire people. We are looking for potential and want to actively foster it. That’s why we encourage you to apply!What we provide- An open and creative team- Agile working hours and workflows- Cross-disciplinary projects- Work on future technologies- Flat hierarchies for your ideas and flexible teams- Our remuneration is based on the collective agreement for the federal states. If you meet all the professional requirements (diploma/master’s degree or doctorate), this position is classified as TV-L E 13. Depending on your professional experience, the basic monthly salary ranges between €4.759,37 and €6.764,69. We will be happy to provide more details during the interview.If you have passion for new technologies and the desire to develop the connected world of tomorrow with us, we are looking for you.Life and science are compatible at our institute. We offer a range of recognised family-friendly measures, such as part-time work, mobile working and flexible working hours that take family needs into account. We also offer support for arriving in Dresden (all formalities, apartment etc.).Application Procedure- Your application should include: CV, copy of university degree certificate- Barkhausen Institut strives for gender and diversity equality. We welcome applications from all backgrounds. Severely disabled persons are given preference in the event of equal suitability.- We only accept complete documents as one single PDF document by e-mail to Kontakt (über Bewerben-Kontaktformular) . Please reference ”Senior Engineer - Digital Hardware-Design” in the subject line. Applications that contain other file formats (e.g. Word, Excel) will not be considered in the selection process. Informal inquiries can also be submitted to the same address.The data submitted by you in the course of the application procedure will be processed by the Barkhausen Institut (BI). BI shall use the data for the purposes of the application procedure. No data shall be passed on to third parties.Schlagworte: BI, IoT, Internet of Things, designer, digital hardware architectures, eda-softwaretools, rtl-designs, frontend, Barkhausen Institut, python, EmpfehlungsbundQuelle/Bewerbung via: https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/308199/senior-engineer-digital-hardware-design-m-strich-w-strich-d (https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/308199/senior-engineer-digital-hardware-design-m-strich-w-strich-d#apply_form)Kurzinfo zum UnternehmenDas Barkhausen Institut ist ein international anerkanntes Forschungsinstitut, das die Brücke zwischen Grundlagenforschung und der praktischen Umsetzung der Vertrauenswürdigkeit vernetzter elektronischer Systeme schlägt.Wir erforschen innovative Informations- und Kommunikationstechnologien, um die Vertrauenswürdigkeit für eine vernetzte Welt zu ermöglichen. Unser Fokus liegt auf Eigenschaften wie Integrität, Zurechenbarkeit, Authentizität, Verfügbarkeit und Datenschutz.Neben unserer anwendungsorientierten Grundlagenforschung engagieren wir uns als Kooperationspartner und als Meinungsführer im Diskurs zum Thema Vertrauenswürdigkeit. Wir legen besonderen Wert auf eine professionelle Wissenschaftskommunikation und suchen den Dialog mit der Öffentlichkeit.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

Open mindedWe are a young, innovative university located in the heart of the Ruhr metropolis. We pride ourselves in outstanding research and teaching, think in terms of opportunities rather than limitations and develop ideas with a view to the future. Diversity is an integral part of our culture as we promote potential and are committed to upholding genuine equity in education.LocationDuisburgApplication areaThe Particle Science and Technology group within the Faculty of EngineeringDoctoral Researcher (f/m/x)TV-L 13 (gross 59.324 € - 84.319 €)The Particle Science and Technology group at the University of Duisburg-Essen conducts research on the synthesis, characterization, functionalization and processing of particles for applications in energy, catalysis and materials science.The position is part of the DFG-funded research project “Uncovering the Interplay Between Iron-Oxide Nanoparticles and Nickel Substrates for Alkaline Oxygen Evolution.” The project investigates how different iron oxide phases (α-Fe2O3, γ-Fe2O3 and Fe3O4) and their interactions with nickel substrates influence catalytic activity during the alkaline oxygen evolution reaction (OER). By combining nanoparticle synthesis, electrode preparation, electrochemical testing and advanced materials characterization, the project aims to establish relationships between material properties, interfacial structures and electrocatalytic performance.Start of employment2027-02-01Duration of employmentInitially 36 months, with the possibility of extensionWorking time39 h 50 min (100 %, part-time employment is possible)Your main tasks1. You synthesize and characterize iron oxide nanoparticles with controlled phase and properties.2. You prepare and optimize catalyst inks and electrode coatings on nickel and reference substrates.3. You perform electrochemical measurements to evaluate catalytic activity and stability during alkaline oxygen evolution.4. You investigate the relationship between nanoparticle properties, FeOx/Ni interfaces and electrocatalytic performance.5. You analyze, present and publish scientific results in collaboration with national and international research partners.You will be given the opportunity to pursue further academic qualification as part of this role.Your profile1. Above-average master’s degree in chemical engineering, chemistry, materials science, physics or a related discipline.2. Strong interest in electrocatalysis, electrochemistry, nanoparticle technology and energy conversion.3. Experience in nanoparticle synthesis, materials characterization, electrochemical measurements or electrode preparation is desirable.4. Independent and systematic working style, high motivation, reliability and strong teamwork skills.5. Very good written and spoken English and willingness to work in an international and interdisciplinary research environmentWe offer you1. lots of variety in a research-focused environment with an international scope.2. An interesting, meaningful job with great potential to shape your role and contribute to innovative research in particle technology, electrocatalysis and sustainable energy conversion.3. An attractive work environment based on mutual appreciation and respect.4. The opportunity to pursue your doctoral qualification with numerous support options.5. A wide selection of further training and education opportunities.6. Various canteens and cafés run by the Studierendenwerk on our campuses.7. Attractive discounts through Corporate Benefits.8. A family-friendly University culture (e.g. care services for your children, advice on family care duties).9. A sought-after location and an infrastructure featuring very good accessibility by public transport and free parking.10. Flexible working hours and the opportunity to work from home (depending on the position).11. 30 days annual leave with a 5-day work week plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve.12. Fair remuneration in accordance with collective agreements (TV-L), including an annual bonus and a supplementary pension scheme.13. jobs.description: OUR COMPANYAt Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.The PositionAt Boehringer Ingelheim, we are committed to delivering breakthrough therapies that have an unprecedented impact for people facing cancer, today and for generations to come. This high-impact global role contributes to our early oncology pipeline, where payer confidence, evidence quality, development and launch sequencing, and pricing strategy can shape how quickly innovation reaches patients. As (Senior) Global Pricing and Access Manager, you will help define the access ambition for early pipeline products and translate science, payer expectations, competitive dynamics and country realities into clear strategic choices. You will work closely with Global Access, HEOR, Medical, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Commercial, Forecasting, Finance, and regional and local teams to ensure payer needs are embedded in evidence generation, value communication, pricing decisions, and launch planning from the beginning.Tasks & responsibilities- In this role, you will drive the development and execution of global pricing and access strategies for early immuno-oncology assets across current and future indications, ensuring payer considerations are integrated into asset and indication planning.- With a focus on value creation, you will develop and refine payer value propositions by translating clinical, economic and market evidence into compelling value narratives.- As part of a cross-functional environment, you will lead payer-relevant evidence planning in partnership with HEOR, Medical and Clinical colleagues, identifying evidence needs, risks and opportunities.- By providing strategic guidance, you will develop global pricing recommendations that support launch planning, lifecycle management, indication expansion and long-term value optimization.- When evaluating market dynamics, you will lead the generation and interpretation of payer, HTA, reimbursement and competitive insights, translating findings into actionable recommendations.- Within your area of responsibility, you will drive access launch readiness across regions and markets, ensuring global strategies and value communications are effectively translated into local implementation.- Through close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders, you will ensure payer and access perspectives are reflected in development, evidence and commercialization planning.Requirements- Graduate degree in Medicine, Life Sciences, Health Economics, Pharmacy, Business, Finance, or a related discipline.- Long term experience in the pharmaceutical industry in Oncology with a strong background in Immuno-oncology market access, pricing, reimbursement or payer authority roles- Demonstrated experience supporting global pricing and access strategy development for Immuno-oncology assets, ideally during pre-launch or launch-phase planning.- Deep understanding of global healthcare systems across major markets and the ability to adapt strategies to market-specific requirements.- Proven ability to independently lead complex cross-functional market access initiatives and translate ambiguity into clear recommendations and actionable plans.- Fluent English communication, presentation and stakeholder engagement skills.As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.comReady to contact us?If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.comRecruitment process:Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until November 19th, 2026. Applications up to November 12th, 2026 are guaranteed to be considered.Step 2: Virtual meeting in the period from end November till Mid of DecemberStep 3: On-site interviews beginning of January
